added: With Custom Figures on, a figure of your own in the Glossary can now be a new figure with its own wording, not only a combination of built-in figures: give it parameters (including options you name and on/off parameters), write how it reads with each parameter in braces, and see how it reads with its defaults. Choose its dance form and its default beats.
Deleting one of your new figures says how many dances use it; each keeps the wording it shows now, as plain text.
`mapUserFigureTemplateText`, `newUserFigureChoiceId` and `userFigurePayloadExtra` for editing a figure of your own (#1023).
changed: `validateUserFigure` reports an over-length template or text default as `UserFigureIssueCodes.tooLong` (an over-length template was `badTemplate`), and refuses repeated choice labels, compared trimmed and ignoring case, so such a definition now reads as needing repair (#1023).
